title: Ukraine tells Putin to ‘stop complaining’ over oil refinery attacks as Russia promises retaliation
summary_full: Ukraine’s foreign minister told Putin to end the war if he wants Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries, after Putin said retaliation was “inevitable.”
